description: Reads how far the build of the webinar on the connected site has come: one card with a bar, a percentage, the step running right now and an honest remaining time, plus `fertig` and the registration and room links once it is done. Read-only, it changes nothing on the site. Call it about every 10 seconds and show the card to the host until `fertig` is true, so they see it moving. Never write or invent texts yourself and never build the webinar a second time: the build is already running. Needs `session_id`; optional `campaign_id` when the session built more than one webinar.

campaign_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when this chat just built one.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_build_status
title: Read the build progress
